column1: # One row per decodeURIComponent() call site. The gate FAILS `--check` on any
# site NOT listed here (status NEW), so a newly-added decode call must be judged
# before it can merge. Judge: can the argument carry a malformed % from the URL
# or a cookie (→ URIError), and if so is the throw caught (try/catch or a
#   STATUS = SAFE (judged a non-bug) | BUG (open, must be fixed)
# Baseline (iteration #13, 2026-06-29): all 7 sites are cookie/hash readers whose
# decode is wrapped in an inline try/catch (or a safeDecodeURI() wrapper that is),
# so a malformed % returns the raw value instead of throwing. All SAFE.

column4: safeDecodeURI(): inline try/catch returns raw s on malformed % (the #ask/50% hash fix).
gate getCookie: inline try/catch returns raw match[1] on malformed % (the gate-IIFE white-screen fix).
getCookie: inline try/catch returns raw cookie value on malformed %.
safeDecodeURI(): inline try/catch returns raw s on malformed % (popstate hash fix).
getC(): inline try/catch returns raw cookie value on malformed %.
getCookie(): inline try/catch returns raw cookie value on malformed %.
parseCookieValue(): inline try/catch returns raw cookie value on malformed % (the shared regex-free reader).
slugFromHash(): inline try/catch returns the raw (un-decoded) slug on malformed %, so a tampered/shared hash cannot brick project routing on boot or hashchange.
fileUrlToPath(): inline try/catch returns the raw (un-decoded) path on malformed % from a dropped file:// URL, so a tampered path cannot throw into the drop handler.
